campus: YOUR CAMPUS NAME (Trisha: replace every guidance line with the campus-approved wording)

recyclable.guidance: Empty and rinse it, then put it in the campus recycling bin.
recyclable.caution: Greasy or wet items may not qualify.

organic.guidance: Put it in the organic / food-waste bin if your campus has one.
organic.caution: Check that no packaging is mixed in.

hazardous.guidance: Do not put it in general waste. Hand it over at the designated e-waste / battery collection point.
hazardous.caution: Safety note: batteries, bulbs and electronics can be harmful. Keep them out of general waste.

general.guidance: Put it in the general waste bin.
general.caution: Could it be reused or reduced next time?

unsure.guidance: Not sure. Take a clearer photo of one item or ask campus staff (check local rule).
unsure.caution: The system is not sure. Do not guess.
